programme.desc: While celebrating the return of his daughter Connie, former lawman McKee is asked to assist in the capture of an outlaw gang. While Joe is courting Connie, no one realizes that McKee is involved with the outlaws.

programme.title: Wagon Train S8E6 The Brian Conlin Story.
programme.desc: Brian Conlin, a delirious and dehydrated Irish immigrant, stumbles into Christopher Hale's camp seeking help. After recovering, he leads Cooper Smith to a group of Irish immigrants whose wagons have broken down. Hale offers to let them join the wagon train, but after enduring repeated rejection and mistreatment elsewhere, the immigrants are reluctant to trust anyone or accept assistance

programme.title: Rifleman S1E26 The Deadly Wait
programme.desc: Dan Maury, a criminal arrested by Micah Torrance, returns from five years in prison determined to avenge himself upon the town marshal

programme.title: Rifleman S1E33 The Money Gun
programme.desc: Bookkeeper Asa Manning hires a professional gunman to eliminate Oat Jackford, a local rancher who suspects him of embezzlement. When the hired killer arrives in town, Lucas McCain is forced to protect the man he once hated

programme.title: Wagon Train S2E38 The Jenny Tannen Story
programme.desc: A young woman travelling to San Francisco to find her famous mother, who abandoned her as an infant, is injured in an accident and faces impending blindness. Major Adams takes her to San Francisco in an effort to reunite her with her mother before she loses her sight

programme.title: McLintock!
programme.desc: Wealthy rancher G. W. McLintock uses his power and influence in the territory to keep the peace between farmers, ranchers, land-grabbers, Indians and corrupt government officials

programme.title: Young Bill Hickok 1940
programme.desc: Roy Rogers saddles up in Young Bill Hickok, an action-packed Western adventure inspired by the early days of the legendary frontier hero. As war clouds gather over a divided nation, Hickok faces treacherous outlaws, secret Confederate plots, and high-stakes gun battles that threaten the peace of the West. With courage, quick draw, and a song on his lips, Rogers brings larger-than-life charm to this thrilling tale of loyalty, justice, and the making of a legend.

programme.title: Django Meets Santana
programme.desc: The small desert town of Black City is held in a reign of terror by a nasty gang of criminals lead by the ruthless Bud Willer. Earnest, but inexperienced Sheriff Jack Ronson arrives in town to establish law and order. Mysterious bounty hunter Django helps Ronson out.

programme.title: Rock River Renegades
programme.desc: Recently elected Marshal Luke Graham falls under suspicion when he's unable to discover the local band of rustlers, which are really led by Jim Dawson, who is also trying to steal Grace Ross, daughter of the local newspaper editor.
